title.en: Unit 3 Notes — Load Calculation for Roof Truss
title.gu: યુનિટ 3 Notes — Roof Truss માટે Load Calculation

h.en: 3.1 Roof truss types, geometry and components
h.gu: 3.1 Roof truss ના પ્રકારો, geometry અને components

items.syllabus_item: 3.1 truss type pitch rise spacing members joints roof covering

body.en:
A roof truss is a triangulated framework carrying roof loads to supports. Common arrangements include king-post, queen-post, Pratt, Howe and north-light trusses; span ranges are indicative, not universal, because roof form, loading, fabrication and available depth govern selection. Span is the support-to-support distance; rise is vertical height from eave level to ridge; pitch may mean slope angle or a rise/span ratio, so state the definition. Truss spacing is the horizontal distance between adjacent parallel trusses.

Principal rafters form the sloping top chords; main tie is the bottom chord; purlins run between trusses to support roofing, and sag ties or sag rods restrain purlins as designed. Eave, ridge, intermediate and middle-bottom joints connect different members through gussets or other details. Roofing examples include GI sheet and fibre-cement (historically AC) sheet. Do not handle or cut asbestos-containing material without applicable specialist health and disposal controls.
body.gu:
Roof truss એ triangular framework છે જે roof loads ને supports સુધી પહોંચાડે છે. King-post, queen-post, Pratt, Howe અને north-light સામાન્ય arrangements છે; span ranges અંદાજિત છે, કારણ કે roof form, loading, fabrication અને depth પ્રમાણે પસંદગી બદલાય છે. Span support-to-support અંતર; rise eave level થી ridge સુધીની vertical height; pitch slope angle અથવા rise/span ratio અર્થમાં હોઈ શકે, તેથી વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો. Truss spacing એટલે પાસેના parallel trusses વચ્ચેનું horizontal અંતર.

Principal rafters sloping top chords છે; main tie bottom chord છે; purlins trusses વચ્ચે roofing ને ટેકો આપે છે અને sag ties/rods design મુજબ purlins ને restraint આપે છે. Eave, ridge, intermediate અને middle-bottom joints માં gussets અથવા અન્ય details થી members જોડાય છે. Roofing ઉદાહરણોમાં GI sheet અને fibre-cement (ઐતિહાસિક AC) sheet છે. Asbestos ધરાવતા material ને specialist health તથા disposal controls વગર હેન્ડલ કે કાપવું નહીં.

h.en: 3.2 Loads, tributary areas and load combinations
h.gu: 3.2 Loads, tributary areas અને load combinations

body.en:
Dead load includes roofing, purlins, bracing, connections and truss self-weight; use material weights and geometry from IS 875 Part 1 and actual section data. Imposed roof load depends on roof use and slope under the applicable IS 875 Part 2. Wind load follows IS 875 Part 3:2015 and relevant amendments; earthquake or other actions apply where required. Load combinations and partial factors follow IS 800 and the relevant loading code.

A purlin supports a tributary strip of sheeting; the truss receives purlin reactions at panel points. If a purlin is simply supported on equal-spaced trusses with uniform line load, each support reaction is half its total load. For an interior truss, reactions from the two adjacent equal spans add; at an end truss only one span contributes unless other arrangements apply. For equal panels an interior point receives half from each neighbouring panel, while an end point generally receives one half panel. Track whether an area is horizontal projection or actual sloping roof area; never mix them silently.
body.gu:
Dead load માં roofing, purlins, bracing, connections અને truss self-weight આવે છે; IS 875 Part 1 અને actual section data પરથી weights તથા geometry લો. Roof use અને slope પ્રમાણે imposed load લાગુ IS 875 Part 2 થી લો. Wind load IS 875 Part 3:2015 અને સંબંધિત amendments મુજબ છે; જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં earthquake અથવા અન્ય actions પણ લાગુ છે. Load combinations અને partial factors IS 800 તથા સંબંધિત loading code પ્રમાણે લો.

Purlin, sheeting ની tributary strip ને ટેકો આપે છે; purlin reactions truss ને panel points પર મળે છે. સમાન અંતરે trusses વચ્ચે simply supported purlin પર uniform line load હોય તો દરેક support reaction કુલ load નો અડધો છે. Interior truss પર બાજુના બે સમાન spans ની reactions ઉમેરાય છે; end truss પર સામાન્ય રીતે એક જ span ફાળો આપે છે. સમાન panels માં interior point ને બાજુના બે half-panels નો અને end point ને સામાન્ય રીતે એક half-panel નો load મળે છે. Area horizontal projection છે કે actual sloping roof area છે તે સ્પષ્ટ રાખો.

h.en: 3.3 Dead load at a roof panel point
h.gu: 3.3 Roof panel point પર dead load

items.syllabus_item: 3.3 dead load self weight purlin bracing roof

body.en:
Measure roof covering weight on the area basis stated by the manufacturer or code. If sheet weight is per m² of sloping surface, multiply by sloping tributary area, not horizontal projection. Purlin self-weight is usually mass per metre from the steel table converted using g; assign to the supporting trusses through reactions. Add truss self-weight and bracing using measured member lengths and masses when available; a preliminary empirical allowance must be labelled and later replaced by actual design quantities.

Example: an interior truss with 4 m spacing and an interior purlin with 2 m sloping tributary width receives roofing area 4 × 2 = 8 m² from adjacent spans combined. End points or end trusses have different tributary areas. Ensure the self-weight of every member is counted exactly once.
body.gu:
Roof covering weight manufacturer અથવા code માં જે area basis પર આપેલું હોય તે પ્રમાણે માપો. Sheet weight sloping surface ના m² દીઠ હોય તો sloping tributary area થી ગુણો, horizontal projection થી નહીં. Purlin self-weight સામાન્ય રીતે steel table ના mass per metre ને g થી રૂપાંતર કરી reactions વડે trusses પર આપો. ઉપલબ્ધ હોય તો measured member lengths અને masses પરથી truss self-weight તથા bracing ઉમેરો; preliminary empirical allowance સ્પષ્ટ લખી પછી actual design quantity થી બદલો.

ઉદાહરણ: 4 m truss spacing અને 2 m sloping tributary width ધરાવતા interior purlin નો adjacent spans નો કુલ roofing area 4 × 2 = 8 m² છે. End points અથવા end trusses માટે tributary area અલગ છે. દરેક member નું self-weight એક જ વાર ગણો.

h.en: 3.4 Roof imposed load on purlin and truss
h.gu: 3.4 Purlin અને truss પર roof imposed load

items.syllabus_item: 3.4 live load per panel point on purlin and truss

body.en:
IS 875 Part 2 specifies imposed loads by roof use, accessibility, slope and other conditions. A commonly taught case for an inclined roof with access only for maintenance starts from 0.75 kN/m² on horizontal projection up to 10°, reducing by 0.02 kN/m² for each degree above 10°, subject to a minimum of 0.40 kN/m²; confirm the exact applicable edition, roof category and clause before use. Snow, maintenance access and other specified actions require separate consideration.

Multiply the applicable imposed load per horizontal projected area by tributary horizontal width to obtain a line load on the purlin, and transfer support reactions to the truss. Apply code combinations after determining characteristic actions. Use the sloping-to-horizontal conversion only once.
body.gu:
IS 875 Part 2 માં roof use, accessibility, slope અને અન્ય conditions પ્રમાણે imposed loads છે. સામાન્ય શૈક્ષણિક કેસમાં maintenance માટે જ access ધરાવતા inclined roof માટે 10° સુધી horizontal projection પર 0.75 kN/m² થી શરૂ કરી 10° પછી દરેક degree દીઠ 0.02 kN/m² ઘટાડવામાં આવે છે, minimum 0.40 kN/m² સાથે; ઉપયોગ પહેલાં લાગુ edition, roof category અને clause તપાસો. Snow, maintenance access અને અન્ય actions અલગ તપાસો.

Horizontal projected area દીઠ imposed load ને tributary horizontal width થી ગુણવાથી purlin line load મળે છે; support reactions truss પર transfer કરો. Characteristic actions નક્કી કર્યા પછી code combinations લગાવો. Sloping-to-horizontal conversion એક જ વાર કરો.

h.en: 3.5 Wind pressure and roof panel loads
h.gu: 3.5 Wind pressure અને roof panel loads

body.en:
IS 875 Part 3:2015 provides design wind speed Vz = Vb k1 k2 k3 k4 for applicable risk, terrain/height, topography and cyclonic importance factors. Wind pressure pz = 0.6Vz² in N/m² when Vz is in m/s. Design pressure pd = Kd Ka Kc pz, subject to the code minimum pd ≥ 0.7pz and applicable provisions. Select coefficients from the code for the site, height, tributary area and load case; do not assume a single value for all buildings.

For an enclosed roof surface, net normal pressure is commonly represented by (Cpe − Cpi)pd. Select external and internal pressure coefficients and signs for each wind direction, roof slope, openings and applicable code figures; suction can produce uplift. Multiply normal pressure by actual tributary surface area for a panel force and resolve into horizontal and vertical components if analysis requires. Check windward and leeward sides, internal-pressure signs and uplift load combinations. Wind coefficients in worked examples are stated assumptions, not site-specific code values.
body.gu:
IS 875 Part 3:2015 મુજબ લાગુ risk, terrain/height, topography અને cyclonic importance factors થી design wind speed Vz = Vb k1 k2 k3 k4 મળે છે. Vz m/s માં હોય ત્યારે wind pressure pz = 0.6Vz² N/m² છે. Design pressure pd = Kd Ka Kc pz છે, code minimum pd ≥ 0.7pz અને લાગુ provisions સાથે. Site, height, tributary area અને load case પ્રમાણે code માંથી coefficients પસંદ કરો; દરેક building માટે એક જ value ન માનો.

Enclosed roof surface માટે net normal pressure સામાન્ય રીતે (Cpe − Cpi)pd થી દર્શાવાય છે. દરેક wind direction, roof slope, openings અને લાગુ code figures મુજબ external તથા internal coefficients અને signs લો; suction થી uplift થાય છે. Normal pressure ને actual tributary surface area થી ગુણતાં panel force મળે છે; જરૂર હોય તો horizontal અને vertical components માં resolve કરો. Windward તથા leeward sides, internal-pressure signs અને uplift combinations તપાસો. Worked examples ના coefficients આપેલ assumptions છે, site-specific code values નથી.

title.en: Numerical 3.1 — Dead load at an interior panel point
title.gu: Numerical 3.1 — Interior panel point પર dead load

body.en:
Given: Trusses are 4 m apart. An interior purlin supports 2 m tributary sloping roof width. Roofing weighs 0.15 kN/m² of sloping surface; purlin self-weight is 0.12 kN/m; an additional 0.30 kN is assigned to this truss panel point for truss and bracing. Find characteristic dead load.

Step 1. Find the roofing tributary area and load.

Tributary area = 4 × 2Tributary area = 8 m²Roofing load = 8 × 0.15Roofing load = 1.20 kN

Step 2. Find the combined purlin reaction and add the stated allowance.

Purlin reaction = 0.12 × 4Purlin reaction = 0.48 kNPanel dead load = 1.20 + 0.48 + 0.30

Final answer:

Characteristic panel dead load = 1.98 kN.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Trusses 4 m અંતરે છે. Interior purlin ની tributary sloping roof width 2 m છે. Roofing weight sloping surface ના m² દીઠ 0.15 kN, purlin self-weight 0.12 kN/m અને આ truss panel point માટે truss તથા bracing ના વધારાના 0.30 kN છે. Characteristic dead load શોધો.

Step 1. Roofing tributary area અને load શોધો.

Tributary area = 4 × 2Tributary area = 8 m²Roofing load = 8 × 0.15Roofing load = 1.20 kN

Step 2. કુલ purlin reaction શોધી આપેલ allowance ઉમેરો.

Purlin reaction = 0.12 × 4Purlin reaction = 0.48 kNPanel dead load = 1.20 + 0.48 + 0.30

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Characteristic panel dead load = 1.98 kN.

title.en: Numerical 3.2 — Roof live load on projected area
title.gu: Numerical 3.2 — Projected area પર roof live load

body.en:
Given: A maintenance-only roof has slope 20°. For this example use imposed load 0.75 kN/m² at 10°, reduce by 0.02 kN/m² per degree above 10°, minimum 0.40 kN/m². Truss spacing is 4 m and sloping tributary width is 2 m. Find characteristic live load at an interior panel point.

Step 1. Find load per horizontal projected area.

q = 0.75 − 0.02 × (20 − 10)q = 0.55 kN/m²

Step 2. Convert sloping tributary width to horizontal width.

Horizontal width = 2 × cos 20°Horizontal width ≈ 1.879 m

Step 3. Multiply by truss spacing and imposed load.

Projected area = 4 × 1.879Projected area ≈ 7.518 m²Panel live load = 7.518 × 0.55

Final answer:

Characteristic panel live load ≈ 4.13 kN.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Maintenance-only roof નો slope 20° છે. આ દાખલામાં 10° પર imposed load 0.75 kN/m² લો, 10° પછી degree દીઠ 0.02 kN/m² ઘટાડો અને minimum 0.40 kN/m² રાખો. Truss spacing 4 m અને sloping tributary width 2 m છે. Interior panel point નો characteristic live load શોધો.

Step 1. Horizontal projected area દીઠ load શોધો.

q = 0.75 − 0.02 × (20 − 10)q = 0.55 kN/m²

Step 2. Sloping tributary width ને horizontal width માં ફેરવો.

Horizontal width = 2 × cos 20°Horizontal width ≈ 1.879 m

Step 3. Truss spacing અને imposed load થી ગુણો.

Projected area = 4 × 1.879Projected area ≈ 7.518 m²Panel live load = 7.518 × 0.55

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Characteristic panel live load ≈ 4.13 kN.

title.en: Numerical 3.3 — Wind force on roof panel
title.gu: Numerical 3.3 — Roof panel પર wind force

body.en:
Given: Assume Vz = 40 m/s, Kd = 0.90, Ka = 0.90, Kc = 1.0, Cpe = −0.9, Cpi = +0.2 and actual roof panel tributary area 8 m². Find net force normal to roof. Values are hypothetical, not a site design.

Step 1. Find wind pressure at height.

pz = 0.6Vz²pz = 0.6 × 40²pz = 960 N/m²

Step 2. Apply factors and minimum-pressure check.

Kd Ka Kc pz = 0.90 × 0.90 × 1.0 × 960Kd Ka Kc pz = 777.6 N/m²0.70pz = 0.70 × 9600.70pz = 672 N/m²pd = max(777.6, 672)pd = 777.6 N/m²

Step 3. Calculate net pressure and force.

Cpe − Cpi = −0.9 − 0.2Cpe − Cpi = −1.1Net pressure = −1.1 × 777.6Net pressure = −855.36 N/m²Panel force = −855.36 × 8Panel force = −6842.88 N

Final answer:

Net force ≈ 6.84 kN suction, normal outward from the roof.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Vz = 40 m/s, Kd = 0.90, Ka = 0.90, Kc = 1.0, Cpe = −0.9, Cpi = +0.2 અને actual roof panel tributary area 8 m² ધારો. Roof પર normal net force શોધો. આ hypothetical values છે, site design નથી.

Step 1. Height પર wind pressure શોધો.

pz = 0.6Vz²pz = 0.6 × 40²pz = 960 N/m²

Step 2. Factors અને minimum-pressure check લગાવો.

Kd Ka Kc pz = 0.90 × 0.90 × 1.0 × 960Kd Ka Kc pz = 777.6 N/m²0.70pz = 0.70 × 9600.70pz = 672 N/m²pd = max(777.6, 672)pd = 777.6 N/m²

Step 3. Net pressure અને force ગણો.

Cpe − Cpi = −0.9 − 0.2Cpe − Cpi = −1.1Net pressure = −1.1 × 777.6Net pressure = −855.36 N/m²Panel force = −855.36 × 8Panel force = −6842.88 N

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Net force ≈ 6.84 kN suction, roof થી normal બહારની દિશામાં.

q.en: What is a truss?
q.gu: Truss શું છે?

a.en: A triangulated framework carrying loads to supports.
a.gu: Loads ને supports સુધી પહોંચાડતું triangulated framework.

q.en: What is a purlin?
q.gu: Purlin શું છે?

a.en: A member spanning between trusses and supporting roofing.
a.gu: Trusses વચ્ચે span કરી roofing ને support કરતો member.

q.en: What is truss rise?
q.gu: Truss rise શું છે?

a.en: Vertical distance from eave level to ridge.
a.gu: Eave level થી ridge સુધીનું vertical distance.

q.en: What is a main tie?
q.gu: Main tie શું છે?

a.en: The bottom chord of the truss.

q.en: What is truss spacing?
q.gu: Truss spacing શું છે?

q.en: Where are purlin reactions applied?
q.gu: Purlin reactions ક્યાં લગાડાય?

a.gu: Supporting truss ના panel points પર.

q.en: What is dead load?
q.gu: Dead load શું છે?

a.en: Permanent load from the structure and fixed materials.
a.gu: Structure અને fixed materials નો permanent load.

q.en: Is roof live load always on slope area?
q.gu: Roof live load હંમેશા slope area પર હોય છે?

a.en: No; follow the specified area basis.

q.en: What does negative roof pressure represent?
q.gu: Negative roof pressure શું બતાવે છે?

q.en: What is Vz?
q.gu: Vz શું છે?

a.en: Design wind speed at height z.
a.gu: Height z પર design wind speed.

q.en: What is pz?
q.gu: pz શું છે?

a.en: Wind pressure at height z before applicable pressure factors.
a.gu: લાગુ pressure factors પહેલાં height z પર wind pressure.

q.en: Why check wind uplift?
q.gu: Wind uplift કેમ તપાસવું?

a.en: Suction can reverse forces and threaten anchorage.
a.gu: Suction force ઉલટાવી anchorage ને જોખમ આપી શકે.
